items.identity: the north Georgia state-line belt (Catoosa, Walker and Dade counties)

identities.name: SpringHill Suites by Marriott Chattanooga South/Ringgold, GA
Super 8 by Wyndham Ft. Oglethorpe GA/Chatt TN Area

evidence.for: Fort Oglethorpe, Ringgold and Rossville sit four to twelve miles from downtown Chattanooga on the same I-75 and I-24 approaches as East Ridge and Lookout Valley, several market themselves as Chattanooga lodging, and the destination bureau promotes them
evidence.against: they are in ANOTHER STATE. This market's contract admits Tennessee municipalities only, and a Georgia tier would need its own corridor, its own postal partition and its own reconciliation. Marketing prose is not geography.
evidence.how_they_were_found: the discovery box reaches deliberately past the state line, and the Wyndham and BringFido lanes were pointed at the Georgia city slugs on purpose, so the belt is CLASSIFIED rather than silently missed

items.proposed_action: admit a north Georgia tier as its own corridor, or keep the belt held
items.recommendation: KEEP HELD for launch. The market publishes comfortably without it, and admitting a second state is a bigger decision than a launch. Every row and its evidence is carried here so a later order can admit a NAMED cluster deliberately, through explicit_hotel_ids on a corridor created for it, and never by widening a postal partition.
items.authority_effect: 11 rows in or out of the clean inventory
items.routing_effect: a new corridor and its routes, or none
items.reversibility: REVERSIBLE -- the rows already exist in the proposed census either way
